unit.title: Kindness, the Golden Temple, and Prayer

lesson.title: A Day in Sikhi Life: Bringing It All Together
lesson.subject: sikhi

contentBlocks.text: This week you learned about kindness, the Golden Temple, and prayer. Today let's see how these three ideas connect into one whole way of living.

Imagine a day that includes all three: starting the morning with a quiet moment of gratitude, choosing kindness toward a family member or friend during the day, and remembering the Golden Temple's example of welcoming everyone equally. These aren't three separate rules — they fit together into one way of living with an open, caring heart. Can you imagine what that kind of day might look like for you?
Kindness, welcome, and gratitude all connect into a real, everyday way of living. Tomorrow is review day — we'll bring together everything from this whole week.

objectives: Explain how kindness, the Golden Temple's welcome, and prayer connect into one coherent way of living
Describe what a day practicing all three might look like for them personally
materialsNeeded: Printed 'A Day in Sikhi Life' worksheet
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review each of this week's three topics briefly.
2. Discuss how they connect — not separate rules, but one way of living with an open heart.
3. Imagine together what a day practicing all three might look like.
4. Move to the worksheet: describe or draw that imagined day.
5. Close by picking one part of that imagined day to actually try today.
differentiationTips: Struggling: focus on just two of the three themes (whichever felt most memorable this week) rather than all three at once
Ready for more: ask the child to connect this synthesis back to last year's Chardi Kala and Equality lessons too
For a child who enjoys drawing, have them illustrate their imagined day instead of writing about it
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is an open-ended, personal reflection activity — there is no single right/wrong answer.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Synthesizing the week's separate lessons into one connected understanding is a core reasoning skill, showing that Sikhi values aren't isolated facts but a coherent way of living.

generationData.instructions: Describe or draw a day that includes kindness, welcome, and gratitude.
